name: Ishida Shuuji
source: Rei's childhood friend. He's a very blunt man who says exactly what he thinks with no concern or subtlety whatsoever. Despite this he's a very good and dependable friend. He's been best friends with Rei for a long time, treating him the same as always even after learning of his family origins.
